svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A hood over the upper disc: 1.5 mm sheet, 118 mm long, 18 mm wide

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside, 64 mm tall, with a 108 mm arched opening for the disc.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front skirt: a 10 mm deep plate down the front of the hood, ending

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 mm above the sheet line and 52 mm ahead of the nip, so a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: finger cannot reach the nip from the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 26 mm hole in the back face for the upper shaft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M5 screws into the upper housing; it does not touch the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: disc (at least 2 mm clear all round).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the head on a drum, nothing thicker than 8 mm passes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the skirt; the guard is on before the crank is turned.
